name.en: Fio Puro Black Wide-Leg Trousers in Wool with a High Rise, Pressed Crease and Full-Length Hem

description.en: Wide-leg wool trousers with a high rise and a pressed crease. The full-length hem works with flats and with a low heel.
description.pt-BR: Calça de lã com perna larga, cintura alta e vinco marcado. A barra longa funciona com rasteira e com salto baixo.
